fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to talk about

fullTextZH: 为什么我不喜欢买东西。
fullTextEN: why I don't like shopping.

fullTextZH: 对，我发现我真的不喜欢买东西，
fullTextEN: Yes, I found that I really don't like shopping,
so I thought about why.
I thought of five reasons,
Yes, five reasons.
The first reason is,

fullTextZH: 我不喜欢做很多、很多工作。
fullTextEN: I don't like doing a lot, a lot of work.

fullTextZH: 现在我的工作是教中文，
fullTextEN: Now my job is teaching Chinese,

fullTextZH: 每个星期我差不多工作20个小时。
fullTextEN: I work about 20 hours a week.

fullTextZH: 所以，我没有很多、很多钱，
fullTextEN: So, I don't have a lot, a lot of money,
but I think it's enough, enough.

fullTextZH: 我不要再做更多的工作。
fullTextEN: I don't want to do more work.

fullTextZH: 如果我做很多、很多工作，
fullTextEN: If I do a lot, a lot of work,

fullTextZH: 那我没有时间学习新的东西，
fullTextEN: then I have no time to learn new things,

fullTextZH: 我没有时间去见我的朋友。
fullTextEN: I have no time to see my friends.
Most importantly,

fullTextZH: 可能我不喜欢我的工作。
fullTextEN: maybe I don't like my job.
So I think, I don't want
to do too much work.

fullTextZH: 因为这个，我没有很多、很多钱，
fullTextEN: Because of this, I don't have a lot of money,
so I can't
buy a lot of things, right.
This is the first reason,

fullTextZH: 为什么我不买很多东西，
fullTextEN: why I don't buy many things,
because I don't have much money.
Why don't I have much money?

fullTextZH: 因为我不要做很多、很多工作。
fullTextEN: Because I don't want to do a lot of work.
The second reason is,
I found I don't care about bags,
I don't care about cars,
I don't care about clothes.
I think bags,
cars, and clothes,
they are all things to use,

fullTextZH: 所以如果可以用就可以。
fullTextEN: so if they can be used, that's fine.
I don't need very expensive things,
I don't need very new things.

fullTextZH: 我觉得，当然有的包包很好看，
fullTextEN: I think, of course, some bags look very nice,
some cars look very nice,
Some clothes look really nice,

fullTextZH: 可是我觉得我可以看看，
fullTextEN: but I think I can take a look,
I don't need to buy my own.

fullTextZH: 对，我不需要买我自己的
fullTextEN: Right, I don't need to buy my own
expensive bags,
expensive cars,
and expensive clothes.

fullTextZH: 如果我买了很贵的包包、
fullTextEN: If I bought expensive bags,
expensive clothes,
maybe I would think, ah,
they are very expensive,
so I need to be a bit careful.
Maybe I won't use them often,
because I think they are too expensive.

fullTextZH: 如果我弄坏了(broke)这个东西，
fullTextEN: If I broke this thing,
I would feel very distressed, right,
my heart would ache a lot.

fullTextZH: 所以，可能如果我买了贵的东西，
fullTextEN: So, maybe if I bought expensive things,
maybe I won't use them often.

fullTextZH: 所以，我不喜欢买贵的东西。
fullTextEN: So, I don't like buying expensive things.
I think,

fullTextZH: 贵的东西可能让你很开心，
fullTextEN: Expensive things might make you very happy,
but not necessarily.
So,

fullTextZH: 你有很多、很多事可以做，
fullTextEN: you have many, many things you can do,
not necessarily expensive things,
not necessarily buying things.
Okay, this is the second reason,

fullTextZH: 就是我不需要贵的东西。
fullTextEN: which is I don't need expensive things.
Okay, the third reason,

fullTextZH: 是因为我没有我自己的房子，对。
fullTextEN: is because I don't have my own house, right.
I don't have my own house,
I have to move often.
When moving,

fullTextZH: 如果你有很多、很多东西，
fullTextEN: if you have many, many things,
you will be very angry.
"Why did I buy so many things?
Now I have to move, what to do?
So many things!"

fullTextZH: 对，所以以前我在北京的时候，
fullTextEN: Right, so when I was in Beijing before,
I often move.

fullTextZH: 然后，搬家的时候，我常常很生气。
fullTextEN: Then, when moving, I often get angry.

fullTextZH: 为什么？因为我买了很多的东西，
fullTextEN: Why? Because I bought a lot of things,
then they all turned into
my burden, right.
I don't really need them,
I bought them, I didn't use them,
but when moving,
they became my burden.
I have to carry them,
so because of this,

fullTextZH: 如果我看到一个东西，我想要，
fullTextEN: if I see something I want,
I will ask myself:
"Do I really need it?
Will I use it?
If I buy it,
will I regret it?"
Generally speaking,

fullTextZH: 如果我问我自己这些问题，
fullTextEN: if I ask myself these questions,

fullTextZH: 我知道我不需要这个东西。
fullTextEN: I know I don't need this thing.

fullTextZH: 那我可以少买很多、很多东西。
fullTextEN: Then I can buy a lot, a lot less stuff.
Yes, this is the third reason,
It's because I often move,

fullTextZH: 所以我讨厌有太多的东西。
fullTextEN: so I hate having too many things.
The fourth reason,
I don't often buy things,

fullTextZH: 可是我有很多的爱好，对。
fullTextEN: but I have many hobbies, yes.
I really like singing🎤,
I really like playing the piano🎹,

fullTextZH: 我很喜欢学一个新的语言。
fullTextEN: I really like learning a new language.
So, these hobbies also cost money.
I bought piano lessons,
I bought singing lessons,

fullTextZH: 我也去学校学习一个新的语言。
fullTextEN: I also go to school to learn a new language.

fullTextZH: 对，我花钱学习新的东西。
fullTextEN: Yes, I spend money learning new things.
The last reason,
I don't often buy things,

fullTextZH: 可是我最喜欢去旅游，对。
fullTextEN: but I like traveling the most, yes.
to see different places.
I think traveling is very expensive, very expensive,
Because you need to buy a plane ticket,
You need to stay in a hotel,

fullTextZH: 你要在那个地方吃饭、去玩。
fullTextEN: You need to eat and have fun in that place.
So you need a lot, a lot of money.
I don't like spending money,

fullTextZH: 可是我喜欢花钱在旅游上。
fullTextEN: But I like spending money on travel.
I found that,

fullTextZH: 很多中国人去旅游的时候，
fullTextEN: When many Chinese people travel,
They also like to buy things,
They like to buy bags,
Buy clothes, etc.
But when I travel,
I also don't like buying things,

fullTextZH: 因为我要把这些东西带回家，
fullTextEN: Because I have to bring these things home,
I think it's very troublesome.
So, when I travel,

fullTextZH: 我只是去吃他们的东西，
fullTextEN: I just go to eat their food,
Go and talk to them,

fullTextZH: 可是我不会买很多东西。
fullTextEN: But I won't buy many things.
Right,
This is me.

fullTextZH: 不喜欢买东西的五个原因：
fullTextEN: Five reasons I don't like shopping:

fullTextZH: 第一个是我没有很多钱，
fullTextEN: The first is I don't have much money,

fullTextZH: 因为我不喜欢做很多工作；
fullTextEN: because I don't like doing a lot of work;
The second is,

fullTextZH: 我觉得我不需要很贵的东西；
fullTextEN: I think I don't need expensive things;

fullTextZH: 第三个是我讨厌有很多东西，
fullTextEN: The third is I hate having a lot of things,

fullTextZH: 因为搬家的时候太麻烦；
fullTextEN: because it's too troublesome when moving;

fullTextZH: 第四个是我有很多爱好，
fullTextEN: The fourth is I have many hobbies,

fullTextZH: 我把我的钱花在爱好上；
fullTextEN: I spend my money on hobbies;
The fifth is I like traveling,
Traveling requires a lot of money,

fullTextZH: 所以我不可以买很多东西。
fullTextEN: so I can't buy many things.
What about you? Do you like shopping?
Do you like to spend your money
on what places?
